shortBio.en: White Stripes vocals/guitar; garage-blues minimalism. Later Raconteurs, Dead Weather, solo.
shortBio.zh: White Stripes 人声/吉他；车库布鲁斯极简。后有 Raconteurs、Dead Weather、独唱。

whyHub.en: Two-piece peak → multi-project hub: same raw amp/slide vocabulary across logos and Third Man Records.
whyHub.zh: 二人组巅峰 → 多项目枢纽：同一毛边音箱/滑棒词汇跨 logo，并落在 Third Man Records。

body.en:
Born 1975, Detroit. White Stripes with Meg White (1997–2011): red/white/black visual, sparse drums, overdriven guitar—Elephant / Seven Nation Army as mass citations. After the duo ends: The Raconteurs, The Dead Weather, solo LPs, and Third Man as label/pressing plant.

Hub: garage method as portable brand; White Stripes tenure is the peak citation.
body.zh:
1975 年生于底特律。与 Meg White 的 White Stripes（1997–2011）：红白黑视觉、稀疏鼓、过载吉他——Elephant / Seven Nation Army 为大众引用。二人组结束后：The Raconteurs、The Dead Weather、独唱专集，以及 Third Man 厂牌/压片。

枢纽：车库方法作为可携带品牌；White Stripes 任期是峰值引用。

note.en: Duo peak; Seven Nation Army mass citation.
note.zh: 二人组巅峰；Seven Nation Army 大众引用。

note.zh: 支线项目；乐队页尚未入编年史。

note.zh: 角色换成鼓；项目未入编年史。
